C5_ATOMIC_SETTLE: A buy (33), multi-buy (2982) or paid refresh (34) is one transaction under the LEAD_SEAMS_I9-11_V2 money path: player root 315 (FOR NO KEY UPDATE), shop row 460 per (player, shop_type), then the I5 suffix 700/710/720/721/722 through PrepareMaterialExchangeTx/ApplyMaterialExchangeTx, state save with its version check, receipt. Multi-buy settles every selected slot or none, one purchase per slot; each slot's balance check subtracts what earlier slots of the same request already billed (sweep C1). A stone price debits the substitute item 50001427 first when it covers the price, else stone_id. Purchases do not overflow to mail; a stack at its cap or a full backpack (economy.ErrStackCapacity, appi5.ErrMailStackFull) refuses 409+35028 before debit, never 500 (11cf F1). A buy or multi-buy never generates stock: a purchase that would need a new generation (missing, or rolled over at 05:00 or a scheduled reroll) refuses 409+40002 and the client re-reads (A-139).
C6_RETRY: Requests carry no nonce or generation (C11 approved): a delivered reply followed by an identical resend is a new operation (a re-sent one-buy slot refuses by its cap; a re-sent paid refresh charges again). R6 replays only an undelivered reply within its window. Every write MID is state in MID_EFFECTS.json; MID 37 is a read (tools/mid_effects.py EVIDENCE_READ_MIDS, 11cf F3); MID 32 is state (it may write the first generation); MID 38 stays unknown, which counts as state for reply replay.
C7_CAP: One accepted purchase per slot per stock generation (C3); isbuy becomes 1 and buy_times counts it; a reroll makes a new generation and clears per-slot state. The D476 overlay may disable or lower availability, never raise the cap. Event shops with their own limits are not 11C.
C8_REFRESH_AND_SCHEDULE: Manual refresh charges refresh_cost[column][refresh_times + 1] in the type's refresh currency, increments refresh_times, rerolls to a new generation and replies with MID 32's shape; refresh_times resets at modes.Day (05:00 GMT+8, C4/F7). Type 13's first five refreshes are free; type 35 has no manual refresh; a type with refresh_time 0 has no schedule; an exhausted ladder refuses 409+35028. Scheduled rerolls at the source times in GMT+8 (type 1 at 09/12/18/21, others 21:00, C4). A read never advances shared time state; generating a player's own missing generation on a 32 read is player state; only reads (32) and paid refresh (34) create generations, never 33/2982 (A-139).
C9_STOCK_GENERATION: Pool row = min(player_level, 100) for 100-row pools (C8), row 1 for single-row tables. B11 approved by the user 2026-11-18 (PRIVATE_POLICY, same shape as the box rule): per slot pick a dropbox group by slotN_rate normalised by the actual sum, then a row by drop_rate normalised by the group's actual sum; never assume 10000. Entropy recipe, stated exactly (A-107 lesson): one stream per generation from Operation.Derive("shop.stock/v1", generation); draws in slot order 1..N, group then row. Freeze item_id, item_num, sell_type, sell_price, discount, stone_id; indices contiguous 1..N; isbuy 0, buy_times 0. A test pins the schedule with a fixed seed.
C10_PRICING: discount 0 rows use sell_price; discount 1 rows (Goblin 4, Black market 5) use sell_price x 0.6, or x 0.55 with an active month card (C9), rounded down (floor; user-approved 2026-11-18, PRIVATE_POLICY); no card discount outside types 4/5. Type 13 uses the base library_shop price while activity 1110 is not live; the 1110 price arrives later through an I10 port (F6) and the D476 overlay never overrides it. Type 13 with a missing or short client_prices is 400 malformed, not 34020/34021 (sweep C2). A client_price that disagrees with the authoritative price refuses 409 with 34020 when the client still shows a discount that has ended, or 34021 when a discount now applies that the client does not show (message.lua rows 34020/34021, message-backed).
C11_TIME_AND_TEMP_MERCHANTS: Timestamps are Unix UTC seconds; schedule-of-day values are GMT+8. Permanent shops return open_time 0, count_down 0. No temporary-merchant spawn is invented (C10): the kind-4 gate values are not client-interpreted, so functions 29/30/36 stay closed until a spawn source is approved; MID 38 closes an open temp shop (3600 s stay, const.lua:38).
